title: Application Evaluation and Performance-Directed Improvement of the Native and Engineered Biosensors.
authors: Li, Min; Chen, Zhenya; Huo, Yi-Xin
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦基于转录因子的生物传感器（TFB）的调控机制、性能优化与工程化应用，并展望AI在编程TFB遗传回路中的潜力，虽涉及TF-DNA识别但未深入结合位点预测或三维互作建模，方法上仅提及AI前景而无具体建模研究。
abstract: Transcription factor (TF)-based biosensors (TFBs) have received considerable attention in various fields due to their capability of converting biosignals, such as molecule concentrations, into analyzable signals, thereby bypassing the dependence on time-consuming and laborious detection techniques. Natural TFs are evolutionarily optimized to maintain microbial survival and metabolic balance rather than for laboratory scenarios. As a result, native TFBs often exhibit poor performance, such as low specificity, narrow dynamic range, and limited sensitivity, hindering their application in laboratory and industrial settings. This work analyzes four types of regulatory mechanisms underlying TFBs and outlines strategies for constructing efficient sensing systems. Recent advances in TFBs across various usage scenarios are reviewed with a particular focus on the challenges of commercialization. The systematic improvement of TFB performance by modifying the constituent elements is thoroughly discussed. Additionally, we propose future directions of TFBs for developing rapid-responsive biosensors and addressing the challenge of application isolation. Furthermore, we look to the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and various models for programming TFB genetic circuits. This review sheds light on technical suggestions and fundamental instructions for constructing and engineering TFBs to promote their broader applications in Industry 4.0, including smart biomanufacturing, environmental and food contaminants detection, and medical science.
abstract_zh: 基于转录因子（TF）的生物传感器（TFBs）因其能够将生物信号（如分子浓度）转换为可分析信号，从而绕过对耗时且劳动密集的检测技术的依赖，在各个领域受到了广泛关注。天然转录因子在进化上优化以维持微生物生存和代谢平衡，而非针对实验室场景。因此，天然TFBs往往表现出较差的性能，如低特异性、窄动态范围和有限的灵敏度，阻碍了其在实验室和工业环境中的应用。本研究分析了TFBs所依赖的四类调控机制，并概述了构建高效传感系统的策略。综述了TFBs在各种使用场景中的最新进展，特别关注商业化挑战。通过修改组成元件来系统提升TFB性能的方法得到了深入讨论。此外，我们提出了TFBs未来发展方向，以开发快速响应生物传感器并解决应用隔离的挑战。进一步，我们展望了人工智能（AI）技术和各种模型在编程TFB遗传电路中的潜力。本综述为构建和工程化TFBs提供了技术建议和基础指导，以促进其在工业4.0中的更广泛应用，包括智能生物制造、环境和食品污染物检测以及医学科学。
